# Vendored browser assets

These files are served locally so the UI works offline. Do not edit them; refresh
by re-downloading the pinned versions below.

| Asset | Version | Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Bootstrap | 5.x (copied from the local scaffold) | https://getbootstrap.com/ |
| Apache ECharts | 6.1.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts@6.1.0/dist/echarts.min.js |
| GridStack | 14.0.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gridstack@14.0.0/dist/gridstack-all.js |

Licenses are included next to each asset (`LICENSE.txt`,
`gridstack-all.js.LICENSE.txt`). ECharts is Apache-2.0; GridStack is MIT.

`gridstack-all.js` is the UMD bundle and exposes the `GridStack` global.
`echarts.min.js` exposes the `echarts` global.
